selection: 8 isolated browser contexts; each test-only in-memory deck contains one untouched actual question per tier; all40 questions exercised
browser: Installed Google Chrome via Playwright; no download
sourceCode: Production app bundled in memory; only QA deck selection and local account endpoints use isolated fixtures. Production UI/game rules unchanged.

manualVisualReview.method: Viewed5 final contact sheets showing all40 actual320px mobile jumbled stages beside revealed full images, plus a full320px astrolabe question screenshot. Originals were separately reviewed.
observations: All40 grids show12 distinct pieces from their own source; dominant identity features are distributed across pieces and originals recover after reveal.
Corrected harp and excavator retain complete subject outlines; pan-flute corrected open-mouth/closed-tip geometry is visible.
Pottery-wheel wording identifies the tool rather than the pot. Roman theatre is a generic semicircular type, not a named site.
Uncommon answers remain recognition challenges supported by aliases; difficulty targets have not been measured with players.
Retained telescope image crops the low ends of tripod legs, while the complete optical tube/mount and three-leg structure remain identifiable; this does not introduce an alternate answer.
Astrolabe inscriptions, musical note counts and geological composition are illustrative; no calibrated instrument, exact model or measured real-site claim.
